lessons.title: 1. yield Basics
lessons.description: A generator function uses `yield` to produce values lazily. Implement `count_up(n)` yielding 1..n.
learning_objectives: Write a generator that yields a sequence

lessons.title: 2. Infinite Generators with take
lessons.description: Implement `take(n, iterable)` that yields the first n items from any iterable.
learning_objectives: Limit an iterable with a generator

lessons.title: 3. Running Average Stream (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Yield the running average after each number in a sequence.
lessons.solution_code:
def running_average(nums):
    total = 0
    count = 0
    for x in nums:
        total += x
        count += 1
        yield total / count

lessons.title: 4. Chunked Reader (Practice)
lessons.description: Yield fixed-size chunks from a list (last chunk may be smaller).
learning_objectives: Slice an iterable into chunks via yield

lessons.title: 5. Unit 17 Checkpoint: Generators
lessons.description: Implement `filter_gen(pred, iterable)` that yields items where pred(item) is true.
